faq.q: How is a titanium neuro guidewire manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium neuro guidewire is manufactured using Laser micro-cutting; Shape-setting heat treatment; Electropolishing. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Nitinol (ASTM F2063) for titanium neuro guidewire?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Conventional machining (higher material waste, longer cycle time).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium neuro guidewire?
faq.a: Titanium Neuro Guidewire components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.

faq.q: What are common failure modes for titanium neuro guidewire?
faq.a: Common failure modes include Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86). BOZE CNC Ti mitigates these through strict process control, proper material selection, and 100% inspection.
